t: What Bearing Failure Database Is All About
title: What Bearing Failure Database Is All About
description: Bearings fail by spalling (fatigue), brinelling (impact dents), and lubrication starvation: the L10 life (90% survive) is computed from load and speed, but contamination kills early. ISO 15243 names the failure modes — read the spall pattern like a language. Vibration (envelope analysis) warns months ahead. The rule: clean lubricant, right viscosity, correct fits. This database is the complete bearing failure: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
